author: Krag, Chief of the Red Ridge band
pages:
Listen up, you lot.

1. Watch shifts are FOUR hours, not "until you get bored." Bjorn, this means you.

2. The road below the ridge is ours. Anyone who passes pays the toll. Merchants pay double. Anyone wearing a fancy hat pays triple.

3. Do NOT rob anyone in full armour carrying a big sword. We have discussed this. We lost Halvar and both Ulfs that way.

4. Stop putting the stolen mead in the same barrel as the drinking water. We are bandits, not animals.

5. If anyone sees a dragon, do NOT shoot arrows at it. Hide in the cave. The last person who shot at a dragon is now a pile of ash near the latrine and we still have not swept him up.

6. Whoever keeps taking my good boots, I know it is you, Sigga.

Payment is on the first of the month, assuming anyone actually robs anyone.

- Krag
